fcf.method: Approx: EBITDA − tax − capex (ΔGross fixed assets) − ΔWorking capital. No cash-flow statement is filed in AOC-4.

accruals.note: Sloan balance-sheet accruals ÷ avg assets — lower is higher earnings quality (profits backed by cash, not accruals).

operatingLeverage.note: Degree of operating leverage = %ΔEBIT ÷ %ΔRevenue (YoY). High |DOL| = profit swings hard with volume.
